rules.description: Examines whether the script follows LAMMPS syntax, avoiding command errors or typos.
rules.example_of_deduction_points: Syntax errors, such as using non-existent LAMMPS commands or spelling mistakes.

rules.description: Assesses whether the script is logically correct in terms of basic physical logic, e.g., whether the lattice structure matches the task requirements.
rules.example_of_deduction_points: Simple logical errors, such as using FCC lattice structure when BCC was required.

rules.description: Examines whether physical parameters (e.g., potential function parameters, ensemble parameters) are scientifically reasonable.
rules.example_of_deduction_points: Parameter errors, such as incorrect L-J potential parameters or wrong NPT settings.

rules.description: Assesses whether the script is correct in core physical computation processes, e.g., whether the density calculation method is accurate.
rules.example_of_deduction_points: Critical computational logic errors, such as using the wrong density calculation method.

rules.description: Assesses whether the script includes all necessary logical steps, e.g., setting up the potential function, temperature control, etc.
rules.example_of_deduction_points: Missing logic, such as not setting a potential function or having no temperature control.

rules.description: Examines whether the script structure is complete, and whether it contains all the necessary logical modules to complete the simulation task.
rules.example_of_deduction_points: Incomplete code, missing large sections of logic, such as only building the structure without simulating any process.
